core_obligations: Prove (1) from the adjunction and injectivity of Q/Z (proof lines 2732-2736).
Show that a split I -> (I^vee)^vee makes I pure injective (proof lines 2736-2737).
Show the evaluation map is universally injective by producing a right inverse for its dual (proof lines 2737-2751).
Deduce (3) and the necessity in (2) from the claim (proof lines 2751-2753).
proof_roadmap: Statement (1) and one direction of (2) (proof lines 2732-2737).
Universal injectivity of the evaluation map (proof lines 2737-2751).
difficulty_reason: For a ring A, with M^vee = Hom_Z(M, Q/Z), the lemma asserts that M^vee is always pure injective, that a module I is pure injective exactly when I -> (I^vee)^vee splits, and that every module admits a universally exact sequence 0 -> M -> I -> N -> 0 with I pure injective (statement lines 2716-2727). The proof derives (1) from the tensor-hom adjunction description Hom_A(N, M^vee) = Hom_Z(N tensor M, Q/Z) and injectivity of Q/Z, which also shows that a split I -> (I^vee)^vee makes I pure injective; the evaluation map is then shown to be universally injective by producing a right inverse for its dual and applying the exact faithful duality functor to N tensor M -> N tensor (M^vee)^vee; finally the claim is used to obtain (3) and the necessity in (2) (proof lines 2729-2753). The level is H3: three statements, with the existence of the right inverse and its consequence displayed.
